account.title: Account
account.body: Sign out here, or use "Sign in as someone else" to switch to another login.

af_overview.title: Overview
af_overview.body: Your starting point for Admin & Finance. Each card (Leads, Jobs, Assignments, Price Sheets, Payments & Payouts, Review, Payroll, Calendar, Reports, Employees) shows a quick count; tap one to open it.

job_create.title: Create a New Job
job_create.body: Fill in the customer, job site address, and service area, then tap "Create". The job starts as New and opens so you can assign techs. Tap "Cancel" to leave without saving.

payroll_rollup.title: Payroll Totals
payroll_rollup.body: Payroll totals appear here once pay runs are set up

af_price_sheets.title: Price Sheets
af_price_sheets.body: Rates and area adjustments, grouped as Drafts, Published and Archived. Tap "Create price sheet" to start a new one.

af_jobs.title: Jobs
af_jobs.body: Every job on file for your organization. Tap a job to open its planning details and estimate.

af_assignments.title: Assignments
af_assignments.body: Match qualified jobs to techs. Choose "Service" or "Prem" for the visit, pick the tech, then tap "Confirm".

af_time_off.title: Time Off
af_time_off.body: Time-off requests from your techs and the upcoming blackouts. Reach it from Calendar: tap "Blackouts" to show every blackout and tick or untick each tech (all on by default), or tap "Add Blackout" to block out dates for a tech.

af_calendar.title: Calendar
af_calendar.body: Scheduled jobs by day or week, by tech. Use the tech picker (All Techs) to look at one person at a time.

job_closeout.title: Close Out the Job
job_closeout.body: The job is paid. An owner or admin reviews the final numbers and closes it out so it moves into history. The job still closes if the price sheet has no commission rate. Any commission lines show in the Payouts tab next to that tech's pay and go out with the next payroll run once the job is closed out. On a closed job, the Close-Out page shows what was paid out, read-only: each technician's flat rate, Prem bonus or commission line, and whether it is waiting for the next payroll run or already included. Hourly technicians do not appear because they are paid from their timesheets. The "Close out job" and "Add photo" buttons are hidden once the job is closed.

af_employees.title: Employees
af_employees.body: Your Employee Roster. Tap "Add Employee" to add someone, or "Pending Invitations" to see invites not yet accepted. Pay is set on an employee's Pay tab: "Base Pay" is one box that follows the Hourly/Flat picker. Employees also get a "Commission" switch with a percent box. Off means base pay only; on adds an extra commission payout on top of base pay, equal to that percent of the job's labor cost. Contractors do not get the switch.

create.title: Create the Lead
create.body: Every job starts as a lead. Open the lead from the Leads list, choose its Source, Payer, Attach timing and Service Area, then qualify it into a real job.

inline_price_sheets.title: How price sheets work
inline_price_sheets.body:
• A price sheet is one versioned set of task prices, trip durations and area adjustments.
• Only one version is Published at a time; techs and estimates always use that one.
• Drafts are private — nothing here changes what techs see until you tap Publish.
• Publish makes this version live and archives the previous one; published versions never change again.
• Price Area Adjustments raise or lower every price on this sheet for the selected service areas, by percent or a flat amount.

af_reports.title: Reports
af_reports.body: Totals for your jobs, including slot Hit Rate and Total Commission. Total Commission now includes each technician's commission lines as well as any older commission records, counted once per job. Tap a line to see the jobs behind the number.

af_review.title: Review
af_review.body: Payment reconciliation. Shows payments that are pending or failed, and payments that were confirmed by hand, so you can spot anything that needs attention.

paid.title: Mark Job Paid
paid.body: After the customer pays, an owner or admin marks the job paid so it stops showing as outstanding. Techs do not see this item.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: App-wide options live here. "Show screen numbers" labels each screen with its number, handy when reporting a problem.

test_jobs.title: Test Jobs
test_jobs.body: Practice with fake jobs that do not affect real work. "Spawn Test Jobs" makes some, "Run Job Simulator" plays one through, and "Delete" or "Delete All" cleans up.

ft_overview.title: Field Tech Overview
ft_overview.body: A summary of your work in tiles: Jobs, Prems Claimed, Time Off, Reimbursements, Notes, Photos and Checklist. Tap a count such as Assigned or Open to see the matching list.

ft_jobs.title: Assigned Jobs
ft_jobs.body: Your schedule of upcoming jobs, shown as a Week or Month calendar. Use Prev, Today and Next to move through dates, and tap a job to open it. Previous Jobs are listed below Next Job.

help_general.title: Help
help_general.body: Use ☰ to move between sections, ⋮ Options for actions here.

ft_prems.title: Prems
ft_prems.body: Lists jobs that need a Prem (premium visit). Tap Claim to take a job (confirm with Yes), then tap Record on a job you claimed to fill in its Prem report.

ft_reviews.title: Reviews
ft_reviews.body: Reviews are coming soon. This view only shows a "Reviews are coming soon." message for now.

arrive.title: Arrive On-Site
arrive.body: When the installer gets to the customer, mark arrival so the clock starts and the office can see progress. Arrive is greyed out until a Service Tech is assigned.

assign.title: Assign Your Techs
assign.body: Pick a Prem Tech for the pre-estimate visit and a Service Tech for the actual work. Assigning does not change the job status.

complete.title: Mark Job Complete
complete.body: When the work is finished, mark the job complete so the office knows it is ready to close out and bill.

contact.title: Contact the Customer
contact.body: Before heading out, reach the customer to confirm the appointment, and log that contact was made.

job_reschedule.title: Reschedule the Job
job_reschedule.body: This job needs a new date. Pick a new date and time on the calendar, then tap "Save" and answer "Yes" to "Reschedule?". Days with other jobs or blackouts are marked, and tapping a day lists them.

jobs_list.title: Your Jobs
jobs_list.body: This is where you find and open jobs. Turn on "Show Test Jobs" to include practice jobs. Tap "New job" to start one.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Update your Name and Email with "Save details". Change your password under "Change password" with "Update password". Only an admin can change roles.

sm_overview.title: Overview
sm_overview.body: A quick snapshot of open callback tasks, Recent reviews and Reporting totals. Tap "Recent reviews" to jump to the Review Library.

sm_callbacks.title: Callback Tasks
sm_callbacks.body: Lists customers waiting for a call back. Tap "Mark Called Back" once you have called. Turn on "Show Test Jobs" to include test jobs.

sm_composer.title: Compose Post
sm_composer.body: Pick a Platform (Facebook or Instagram), write the caption and add approved assets, then tap "Approve draft". After that use "Export images, copy caption, share" or direct post.

sm_reporting.title: Marketing Reporting
sm_reporting.body: Shows "Posts by platform and period", "Assets used", "Reviews collected", "Jobs by source" and "Jobs by attach timing". It is read-only.

sm_pitch.title: Pick a Pitch Angle
sm_pitch.body: Choose how to build a post: "Service line", "Community", "Seasonal" or "Before / after". Tapping one opens the Composer with that angle.

sm_reviews.title: Review Library
sm_reviews.body: Browse published reviews and filter by "Minimum rating", "Service" and "Community". Tap "Curate as testimonial" to save one; use the up and down arrows to reorder.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: See scheduled work by day or week. Use the toggles to show or hide "Jobs", "Time Off", and "Show Test Jobs". Tap "Blackouts" to see every scheduled blackout and tick or untick each tech (all on by default), or "Add Blackout" to block out dates for a tech.

help.title: Account
help.body: Sign out here, or use "Sign in as someone else" to switch to another login.
